question: In honour of an Indian musician, the US state of Massachusetts proclaimed 20 April as __________ in 1984.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amjad Ali Khan Day**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Amjad Ali Khan** (born 9 October 1945) is an Indian classical **sarod player**, best known for his clear and fast ekhara taans.
 
• Khan first performed in the United States in 1963 and continued till 2000
 
• The U.S. state of Massachusetts proclaimed 2**0 April as Amjad Ali Khan Day in 1984**.
 
• Khan was awarded the 21st Rajiv Gandhi National Sadbhavna Award.
 
• Khan received **Padma Shri** in 1975, **Padma Bhushan **in 1991, and **Padma Vibhushan** in 2001, and was awarded the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** in 1989 and the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship** in 2011.
